title: Summary tape cell contents
statement: For an optional Boolean summary symbol, a finite Boolean word, and an integer position $z$, define the cell contents to be the summary symbol when $z=0$, and otherwise to be the buffer-tape contents of the word at position $z-2$.
hypotheses_covered: The summary symbol is optional and Boolean when present
The word is a finite Boolean string
caveat: The buffer-tape contents function is not defined in the supplied context.
